відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The glossy burgundy pumps and the wine-red bag pick up the same deep red, so the outfit has one clear accent. The golden earrings add a small warm shine near your face without competing with it. You asked to stand out at work, and this does it with colour and a sharp line rather than volume. The soft peach blouse against graphite grey is warm and fresh, and it keeps the look right for an office day. The fitted blazer and tapered trousers draw one clean vertical line from shoulders to ankle, and the narrowed hem anchors the outfit at the ankle. The red pumps set the eye at the feet and lengthen your leg. In autumn the graphite layers keep you comfortable all day, and the pumps are smooth enough to stay polished between desk and meetings.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Tuck the peach blouse into the graphite trousers so the blazer has a clean waistline to sit on.\",\"Wear the graphite blazer buttoned for meetings and open at your desk, so the peach shows as a soft panel of colour.\",\"Let the burgundy pumps and the wine-red bag be the only strong accent, and keep the golden earrings as the one shiny detail near your face.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#43·40\",\"what\":\"peach blouse\"},{\"n\":\"#415·12\",\"what\":\"graphite tapered trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#444·35\",\"what\":\"graphite fitted blazer\"},{\"n\":\"#540·07\",\"what\":\"burgundy glossy pumps\"},{\"n\":\"#59·35\",\"what\":\"wine-red bag\"},{\"n\":\"#122·35\",\"what\":\"golden earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#43·40\",\"text\":\"A blouse in a soft peach shade, a warm and gentle colour that brightens the face.\"},{\"n\":\"#415·12\",\"text\":\"Slim graphite-grey trousers with a tapered leg that narrows toward the ankle, giving a clean, elongated line.\"},{\"n\":\"#444·35\",\"text\":\"A fitted blazer in deep graphite grey, cut close to the body to give a sharp, defined line through the shoulders and torso.\"},{\"n\":\"#540·07\",\"text\":\"Pumps in a deep burgundy red with a glossy finish, a polished and confident touch for the feet.\"},{\"n\":\"#59·35\",\"text\":\"A bag in a muted wine red, a rich and quiet shade with a structured, practical look.\"},{\"n\":\"#122·35\",\"text\":\"Golden earrings with a shiny finish, a small warm glint that frames the face.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":7197,"output_tokens":1606},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
